name: great-lakes-toteops
description: Great Lakes ToteOps - Rental Inventory, Dispatch and Field Operations for Great Lakes Moving Totes LLC

scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:worker && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env preview
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:worker && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:worker && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply glmt-db --env preview --remote
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply glmt-db --env production --remote
